claims: C1 the chain of command is designed to maximize steerability and control for users and developers
C2 the chain of command enables users and developers to adjust the model's behavior to their needs
C3 such adjustment stays within clear boundaries

concepts.name: chain_of_command_principle
concepts.gloss: the principle that instructions with higher authority override those with lower authority, designed to maximize steerability and control
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the node's NEEDS contract assigns (mechanical licence correction under DECISION_licence_textual.md, 2026-08-16)

concepts.name: steerability_and_control
concepts.gloss: the property of the chain of command that lets users and developers direct and control the model's behavior

concepts.name: adjusts_behavior
concepts.gloss: the chain of command enables its user or developer to adjust the model's behavior to their needs

concepts.name: within_clear_boundaries
concepts.gloss: the adjustment of the model's behavior stays within the clear boundaries set by the chain of command

concepts.name: user_or_developer
concepts.gloss: a person or entity that uses the model or develops with it, whose needs the chain of command serves

ontology.gloss: the chain of command C is designed to maximize steerability and control for users and developers
